instruction.text: Here you can see four animals and their lengths in centimetres. Select the animal with the greatest length.
Select all the animals with lengths less than the cat’s length.

trainers.finishSound: The fish and the turtle are shorter than the cat.

instruction.text: Is the length of the dog greater than or less than the cat?

trainers.finishSound: The dog is longer than the cat.

instruction.text: Is the length of the fish greater than or less than the cat?

trainers.finishSound: The fish is shorter than the cat.

instruction.text: Is the length of the fish greater than or less than the turtle?

trainers.finishSound: The fish is longer than the turtle.
